author: killix
text: Published agent evals run on repos that fit in one context window. The internal ones run on monorepos where a change lands three teams away. Neither counts the runs you kill at minute six. I killed four yesterday and the success rate I report to myself didn't move.

author: MrGeorgeCheng
text: Open weights do not make an AI stack portable. DeepSeek's new model ships vLLM and SGLang paths, which exposes the real test: run the same agent evals on both. If tools, vision, or recovery diverge, your inference engine is the lock in.

author: killix
text: Agent evals count the runs that finished. We count the ones we threw out: a run gets marked discarded if a human edits the same file by hand within 24h of it landing. That bucket is bigger than our failure bucket, and no published eval has a column for it.
